description: This Java source file defines a utility container class 'AcknowledgementRequests' for creating and parsing AcknowledgementRequest objects. It provides factory methods for instantiation, deserialization from JSON, and parsing from string representations, encapsulating the logic related to acknowledgement request handling within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequests
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods and deserialization/parsing logic for AcknowledgementRequest objects. It acts as a namespace for related functions, ensuring controlled creation and parsing of acknowledgement requests.

methods.name: newAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableAcknowledgementRequest instance based on the provided AcknowledgementLabel.

methods.name: newFilteredAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableFilteredAcknowledgementRequest with specified included requests and filter.

methods.name: filteredAcknowledgementRequestFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonObject into a FilteredAcknowledgementRequest instance.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence representation into an ImmutableAcknowledgementRequest, throwing specific exceptions on failure.
